run_simulation: run the pybullet simulation script that stacks 10 cubes using the Dantzig constraint solver
switch_constraint_solver: switch the pybullet physics engine constraint solver between LCP_PGS and LCP_DANTZIG modes
configure_solver_parameters: configure the pybullet solver residual threshold and number of solver iterations for the simulation
load_urdf_objects: load URDF objects like plane and cube_small into the pybullet physics simulation environment
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation in a loop at 240 Hz while the GUI connection is active
